title: SSC Selection Post 14th Exam City 2026
postName: Selection Post Phase XIV - Matric, Intermediate and Graduate Level
vacancyDetails: SSC Selection Post Phase XIV: 3,003 vacancies across Matriculation, Higher Secondary and Graduation level posts
qualification: Matriculation, 10+2 Intermediate or Bachelor Degree depending on the notified post
ageLimit: 18 to 25-30 years, post-wise; age relaxation as per SSC Selection Post rules

shortDescription: SSC Selection Post 14th Exam City 2026 for 3,003 Matric, Intermediate and Graduate level posts. The computer-based examination is scheduled from 16 to 26 September 2026.
content:
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Selection Post Phase XIV Exam City details 2026 for Matriculation, Higher Secondary and Graduation level posts.

The recruitment covers 3,003 posts across SSC regions. The computer-based examination is scheduled from 16 September to 26 September 2026. Candidates should log in to the SSC portal to check their exam city and download the admit card when activated.

Exam instructions

  • Check your exam city, date, shift and reporting time on the official portal.
  • Carry the printed admit card and original valid photo ID.
  • Follow the instructions printed on the admit card and SSC exam notice.
